text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

INDIA, Aug 27 - Bombay - two vessels loading at berth, 26 discharging at berth, 2 discharging at anchorage, 6 waiting at anchorage to load, 20 waiting to discharge, 1 bunkering, 3 under repairs, 2 awaiting orders. Delays - containers 3-4 days, bulk cargo 12-15 days, General Cargo 15-20 days. Occasional rains have hampered cargo operations. Floating crane laid up for indefinite period. Calcutta - five vessels loading at berth, 11 discharging at berth, 2 vessels bunkering. Vessels due - 4 products tankers, 6 coal, 1 palm oil. 15 crude tankers due, 15-16 days delay.

Cochin - two container vessels loading, 1 tanker waiting at anchor to load, 2 vessels dry-docked. Berthing delays - containers/breakbulk no delays, fertiliser/general cargo up to 1 day, scrap depending on receiver's readiness to take direct delivery. S.W. monsoon active, affecting operations to some extent. Mormugao - Two vessels loading at berth, 1 discharging, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 3 under repairs/dry-docked, 1 awaiting orders, 7 due (1 phosphoric acid, 1 research vessel, 2 molasses, 2 petroleum, 1 caustic soda), 1-2 days delay.

Jawaharlal Nehru - two vessels discharging at berth, 1 discharging iron ore at anchorage, 2 fertiliser/raw materials vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge, 6 due of which 4 raw materials with 10-12 days delay and 2 iron ore with 3-4 days delay. Intermittent heavy rain expected. Harbour tug officers strike called off from 1300 Aug 20. From Aug 20 to 31 priority Being Given to vessels carrying urea on government account at one berth at a time.

Kandla - five vessels loading at berth, 1 loading at anchorage, 2 discharging at berth, 8 vessels waiting at anchor to load, 3 waiting at anchor to discharge, 3 tankers berthed, 11 waiting. 14 vessels due of which 4 scrap, 2 rice (all with 15-16 days delay), 1 rock phosphate (5-6 days delay), 2 steel coils/CKD (7-8 days delay), 3 TEUs (4-5 days delay), 1 granite blocks, 1 wheat (both with 10-12 days delay).

Mangalore - five vessels loading at berth, 2 discharging at berth, 1 vessel waiting at anchorage, 1 vessel under arrest, 10 due, 1-2 days delay. In the evening of Aug 25 fire damaged the KOCL pellet plant. Two conveyor belts have been completely burnt out. However, supplies will continue as usual from stockpiles.

Madras - five vessels loading at berth, 7 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to load, 3 waiting to discharge, 1 awaiting orders, 43 due of which 8 coal/coke, 1 fertiliser, 2 edible oil, 1 sugar, 9 containers, 14 general cargo, 2 other vessels, 1 caustic soda, 1 phosphoric acid, 1 logs, 1 iron ore. Delays expected - coal/coke 4-5 days, fertiliser 3-5 days, scrap 2-3 days, others 3 days. No delays for containers/iron ore.
Tuticorin - five vessels loading at berth, 4 discharging at berth, 1 discharging at anchorage, 3 waiting at anchorage to load, 2 to discharge, 3 due, 1-2 days delay.

Paradip - five vessels loading at berth, 2 discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchor to load, 1 to discharge, 7 due of which 2 coal, 1 chrome (3 days delay), 1 iron (1 day delay), 1 oil (2 days delay), 1 general cargo, 1 food (both with 4 days delay). 15 days delay expected for fertiliser and scrap. Monsoon prevailing but no major delays in cargo operations.

Visakhapatnam - seven vessels loading at berth of which 2 structures, 1 export sugar, 1 export granite, 1 export cement, 2 export thermal coal. 7 discharging at berth of which 1 import general cargo, 1 import MOP, 1 import urea, 1 import RBD palmolene, 1 import sulphur, 1 import coking coal. 8 waiting at anchor to discharge at inner harbour berth of which 6 import coking coal, 1 import steel rails/general cargo, 1 import empty containers. 4 waiting at anchor to load at inner harbour berth of which 1 export iron ore, 1 export alumina powder, 1 export bagged rice, 1 export TNA pills. 12 vessels due of which 2 export iron ore, 1 export molasses, 1 import liquid ammonia, 1 import laden containers, 1 import vegetable oil (all with up to 1 day delay expected), 1 export pig iron, 1 export granite blocks, 1 export chrome, 1 import rock phosphate, 1 import limestone, 1 import magnesite (all with 7-8 days delay expected).

MALAYSIA, Aug 28 - Port Kelang - container berths - 2 vessels berthed, 1 berthing Aug 28. Deep draft conventional wharves - 4 vessels berthed, 2 berthing Aug 28, 1 waiting. Dry bulk terminal - 2 vessels berthed, 3 waiting with approx. 4 days waiting time expected. West Port - 3 conventional vessels berthed, 2 cement carriers berthed and discharging, wharf occupied by a passenger vessel, 1 container vessel berthed. No vessels waiting.

PAKISTAN, Aug 26 - Karachi - two vessels loading at berth (1 rice, 1 chrome), 3 loading/discharging containers at berth, 13 discharging at berth (sugar, logs, urea, general cargo, palm oil, dap, scrap, HSD), 5 vessels waiting at anchorage to load (general cargo, containers, oil tanker, sugar, fuel oil), 1 anchored waiting to discharge urea, 2 vessels awaiting orders, 2 vessels due. Delays dry cargo 24 hours, dangerous goods 2 days.

PHILIPPINES, Aug 26 - Manila - South harbour - 12 vessels discharging at berth, 11 discharging at anchorage, 6 vessels waiting at outside anchorage to discharge, 1 other vessel (awaiting orders etc). Average waiting times - vessels with drafts less than 8.5 metres and LOA less than 130 metres - 3-5 days. Vessels with drafts greater than 9 metres and LOA greater than 140 metres - 4-7 days.

SINGAPORE, Aug 26 - Tanjong Pagar container terminal - 7 container vessels berthed. Keppel terminal - 7 container/general cargo vessels berthed. Pasir Panjang terminal - 7 container/general cargo vessels berthed. Sembawang terminal - 3 general cargo vessels berthed. Jurong port - 2 bulk cargo/steel/general cargo vessels berthed. Oil terminals/SBM buoys - 14 tankers berthed. Minimal berthing delays at all terminals/ports/buoys. Widespread rain with winds can be expected this week in the mornings and early afternoons.

SRI LANKA, Aug 27 - no labour problems. Colombo - 16 vessels loading at berth (13 containers, 3 breakbulk), 24 discharging (9 break bulk, 1 ro/ro, 1 bulk cement, 13 containers). General cargo vessel waiting at anchorage to load vehicles, 10 waiting to discharge (5 containers, 1 rice, 1 steel, 1 LPG carrier, 1 general cargo, 1 ro/ro), 3 vessels bunkering outside harbour, 6 under repairs/dry-docked, 6 awaiting orders, 8 vessels due, 3-4 days delay expected. Occasional rains towards end of the day. Galle - one vessel discharging at berth, 1 loading. Trincomalee - one vessel discharging at berth.

SOUTH KOREA, Aug 27 - Inchon - 94 vessels in port (51 berthed, 43 anchored) of which berthed 8 logs, 7 steel, 6 general cargo, 3 cars, 3 containers, 3 scrap, 2 pulp, 2 wheat, 2 cottonmeal, 2 pig iron, 2 coils, 2 sugar, 2 wheat pellets, 1 granite, 1 talc, 1 rapeseed meal, 1 copra, 1 soymeal, 1 salt, 1 corn. Vessels anchored - 6 general cargo, 6 logs, 4 coils, 3 tapioca, 3 steel, 3 scrap, 2 cars, 2 soda, 2 plywood, 2 pulp, 1 rapeseed meal, 1 copra, 1 cottonmeal, 1 pellets, 1 fertiliser, 1 soybeans, 1 wheat pellets, 1 ingots, 1 talc, 1 containers, 1 corn. Approx. 3 Days delay expected.
Busan - 173 in port (52 berthed, 121 anchored including 60 laid-up) of which berthed 37 general cargo, 8 containers, 4 scrap, 3 coal. 61 awaiting berths, 2-3 days delay expected.

Pohang - 27 vessels in port (18 berthed, 9 anchored) of which berthed/discharging 3 steel billets, 2 iron ore, 2 plate, 1 coal, 1 pipes, 1 scrap, 1 slabs, 1 steel products. 6 steel vessels loading, 9 vessels awaiting berths with approx. 2-3 days delay expected.

Ulsan - 26 vessels in port (22 berthed, 4 anchored) of which berthed/discharging - 4 chemicals, 2 feedmeal, 1 general cargo, 1 methanol, 1 cement, 1 sulphur, 1 woodchips, 1 wheat, 1 zinc concentrates, 1 copper concentrates, 1 crude oil, 1 diesel oil. Vessels loading - 1 containers, 1 steel pipes, 1 ammonium sulphate, 1 general cargo, 1 base oil, 1 gas oil. 4 feed vessels awaiting berths, approx 15 days delay due because of shortage of silo space.
Masan - six vessels in port (all berthed) of which discharging 1 bananas, 1 steel structures, 1 ferrochrome, 1 scrap, 1 logs. 1 car vessel loading, no delays.
TAIWAN, Aug 24 - Keelung - four vessels anchored. Berthing delays - Coal - 5 days. Steel/iron ore - 3 days. No delays for grain.
Kaohsiung - three vessels anchored. Berthing delays - iron/coal (CSC berth)/grain - 2 days. Coal/scrap (public berth)/steel - 1 day.
Taichung - seven vessels anchored. Berthing delays - grain - 6-7 days. Iron ore/coal/steel/others - 1-2 days. No delays for scrap.

Keelung - Aug 26 - twenty-six vessels in port of which 13 containers, 1 tanker, 9 other bulkers, 3 general cargo. 7 container vessels waiting at outer anchorage. Average berthing delays - containers - 1 day.

Kaohsiung - seventy-three vessels in port of which 11 containers, 7 tankers, 1 grain, 3 other bulkers, 38 general cargo, 13 at buoys. 4 general cargo vessels waiting at outer anchorage with 2 days berthing delay expected.
